inlines.v: INCOMPLI'ANCE, noun [in and compliance.] 1. Defect of compliance; refusal to comply with solicitations. 2. Untractableness; unyielding temper or constitution. Self-conceit produces peevishness and incompliance of humor in things lawful and indifferent.
